assertions: Raw binary UNO stream wrappers retain original Reference ownership, buffers and position/EOF semantics.
Original input/output exception and autoclose asymmetries are preserved.
record.capability: Original OOXML raw UNO binary stream transport
gaps: Original BinaryStreamBase/BinaryXSeekableStream/SequenceSeekableStream position, EOF, alignment and actual UNO Reference owners plus BinaryXInputStream/BinaryXOutputStream raw transport and BinaryInputStream::copyToStream. Native virtual-base identity is lowered through a role mixin. Actual 32KiB Sequence buffers, two seeking queries, signed64-bit positions, count/atom loops, typed-only catches with owned exception cleanup and reverse member destruction are retained. CALC-360/WRITER235 preserve unconditional input closure despite false autoclose; CALC-361/WRITER236 preserve stale-buffer copy from an already-EOF input. Nine tests pass; unchanged whole-three-owner100 gate FAILS S176/176 B82/83 F32/32 L163/163 because the final sub32KiB copy request needs almost SAL_MAX_INT64 bytes. Source/counters/exclusions/thresholds unchanged. Numeric/array/string convenience templates, relative/Sequence binary input implementations, services, package/SAX encoding transport, full model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain pending. Physical ABI/pointers/native threads/overflow/undefined atom sizes and original compiled differential are unverified. Existing browser file/autosave/recovery policy is unchanged.
